part.text: All verification passes. Final state of the fix:

Fixed. The issue was that the `paging` clap argument didn't have an override relationship with the `no-paging` (`-P`) argument, so a `--paging=always` (from the config file, whose args are prepended, or from an earlier CLI arg) always won regardless of a later `-P`.

In clap 2, `overrides_with` is POSIX-style ("last one wins"), so `-P` appearing after `--paging=always` now correctly disables the pager — this mirrors the upstream bat fix for issue #2201 (commit `9c7ca339`).
